description: Before moving a project to a new Node.js version (e.g. off Node 20 to 22 or 24), checks each npm dependency's declared Node support (its engines field). For each that doesn't support the target, gives the smallest newer release that does, with that upgrade's risk. Works from a package-lock.json without installing anything.

limit.description: Max breaking changes shown for each suggested fix

node.description: Target Node.js version: a major like 24 (means the latest 24.x) or an exact 22.11.0

requirements.description: The project's dependencies: the contents of package-lock.json (best), package.json, or one 'name@version' per line

name: node_check
title: Will my npm dependencies run on this Node.js version?
